subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` gate now?
rationale: The code is narrow and default-compatible, but the remaining question is whether operators should get an officially supported way to make info-level secret-audit findings non-failing.

options.title: Close for now
options.body: Do not keep this contributor branch open as a landing candidate until a secops or maintainer owner sponsors the audit-policy contract.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the opt-in threshold because plain `--check` remains backward-compatible and the PR already includes docs, tests, and terminal proof.

options.title: Request a narrower shape
options.body: Ask for a narrower name, docs framing, or limited policy if maintainers only want this for specific info-only legacy residue cases.

recommendation.title: Close for now
recommendation.body: Do not keep this contributor branch open as a landing candidate until a secops or maintainer owner sponsors the audit-policy contract.
